title: Construction Cadet
abstract: Launch your construction career with Rohrig today!
bullets: Exciting start to your career in construction
Exposure to diverse range of projects
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
content_text:
Our Company
Rohrig is a commercial construction company based across Brisbane, the Gold Coast and Sydney, priding ourselves on creating lasting value for our clients. Over the last 35 years, we have nurtured an outstanding culture and a supportive team environment. With continued growth across the Gold Coast and Northern Rivers region, we have an exciting upcoming opportunity for a Construction Cadet to join our team in Tugun, Gold Coast.
Our People and Perks
We focus on attracting and retaining talented individuals while promoting a fantastic culture and perks that include an annual conference and awards night, access to Executive Health Solution program, Rohrig Social Club, competitive remuneration and opportunities to upskill and develop your career to its full potential.
Our Role
As a Cadet, you will gain hands-on experience across all facets of the construction industry, including Contract Administration, Estimating, Design Management and Site Operations. Working alongside experienced industry professionals, you will receive mentoring and practical exposure to real projects, helping you develop the technical and professional skills required for a successful career in construction.
You will support our Construction Managers and Project Teams with:
- Coordinating and liaising with subcontractors, suppliers and consultants
- Assisting with client and superintendent communications
- Attending site and project meetings
- Supporting project cost tracking and financial administration
- Processing invoices and progress claims
- Maintaining project documentation and document control systems
- Assisting with contract administration activities
- Contributing to project planning, coordination and delivery
- Providing general project and administrative support to the wider team
About You
- Reliable, honest and hardworking
- Great communication skills
- Effective time management and attention to detail
- Ability to work well in a team and autonomously
Required qualifications:
- Second to final year student in a Construction Management degree
- Relevant practical experience beneficial but not required, some form of work history will be highly regarded
- Drivers licence & own reliable car
Join Rohrig and develop your career through hands-on experience across a range of construction projects, supported by industry-leading mentors and project teams.
